text:
Olivia (CS): heads-up — Montara dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. main asks: quota priming, autoscale thresholds, and a quick soak load profile. who can pair on the autoscale probe?
Ana (SRE): I can do the autoscale policy review at 08:00 PT. need their peak tokens/sec and expected p95 latency SLO.
Mike (Infra): I have their reserved pool specs. planning 4x A100s, but they asked for burst to 6. need to validate burst triggers (cpu/gpu mem / queue depth).
Jamie (Account): Montara will be on the call, they want a 30-min enablement + handoff after the run. also concerned about renewal risk if first-week latency spikes.
Olivia (CS): noted — renewal risk flagged. objective: show stable p95 <= 180ms under steady 1.2M tokens/hr and graceful degradation to p95 <= 450ms at 2x.
Ana (SRE): proposed autoscale probe steps: 1) neutral traffic baseline 15m, 2) staged ramp to 1.2M tokens/hr over 10m, 3) 30m steady, 4) rapid spike to 2.4M for 10m, 5) cooldown.
Mike (Infra): add: prefix cache warm (3 priming requests per model shard) before baseline. otherwise initial cold will skew metrics.
Jamie (Account): can we show a fallback policy? Montara asked for model-variant fallback to a quantized v1 for spikes.
Ana (SRE): yes — routing policy: primary -> rtx-large, fallback -> rtx-quant-8bit; test via tag override. will simulate by injecting node drain at step 4.
Olivia (CS): ops checklist for tomorrow?
Mike (Infra): short checklist:
```
- confirm reserved quota in console (Montara org id: mont-881)
- pre-load cache: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serve/prime` (run 3x)
- deploy autoscale policy: `policy=montara-surge-2026-03`
- enable tracing for route: montara/prod
- set alert thresholds: p95>250ms, queue_depth>200
```
Ana (SRE): i'll post the autoscale policy diff to #eng-sre 30m before. can someone on CS ping Montara to have engineer on the call?
Jamie (Account): pinged them, they confirmed: Priya (Montara Eng) will join.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for montara/prod @jamie -> #eng-releases (run id: dpl-8743) :white_check_mark:
Ana (SRE): test plan snippet for load generator (k6 + custom token payload):
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m script.js --env TARGET=https://montara.redwood/prod
// script.js hits /generate with varied sequence lengths
```
Olivia (CS): what about quotas — are there soft limits in hosted control plane that might throttle their warmup?
Mike (Infra): quota: committed tokens/hr = 1.5M, burst allowed = 2.5x for 15m windows. I will temporarily raise the per-route burst window to 20m for the run.
Jamie (Account): Montara asked to capture feedback on enablement docs and handoff notes during the run. I'll record action items.
Olivia (CS): can we add a brief post-run survey? one question: 'Was the onboarding clear enough to run at expected throughput?' yes/no + comment.
Jamie (Account): will send to Priya immediately after.
Ana (SRE): risks: a) cache warm failure b) autoscaler oscillation c) model fallback not accepting kv cache. mitigations: a) scripted priming, b) hysteresis 120s, c) pre-validate model-variant compatibility.
Mike (Infra): I'll schedule an emergency rollback window: 10:10–10:30 PT reserved for fallback to last known-good config.
Olivia (CS): time check — run at 09:00 PT, call link in calendar invite. I'll lead post-run recap. can everyone confirm availability?
Ana (SRE): confirmed.
Mike (Infra): confirmed.
Jamie (Account): confirmed.
Olivia (CS): thanks — i'll post a short summary and the artifacts (logs, heatmaps, alerts) to the Montara workspace after the run. :thumbsup:
Olivia (CS): post-run action items (will capture during call):
- collect p95 & throughput heatmap
- note any autoscale thrash windows
- confirm fallback efficacy
- survey to Montara engineer
- update onboarding doc with priming snippet if needed
Olivia (CS): tagging this thread as the canonical coordination record for the bring-up.
Mike (Infra): FYI i've attached the temp quota bump ticket #INC-8832 to the invite (link in calendar).
Olivia (CS): perfect. see you all 09:00 PT — closing thread for prep, will reopen with run logs. :rocket:
